verdict.rationale: The pack shows only that Sentry has a pricing page describing a free solo-developer tier and its included features (Error Monitoring and Tracing, alerts, dashboards, MCP access), plus SAML/SCIM as a plan feature. No evidence shows published per-signal rates (per error, span, replay, or log) or self-serve cost estimation, so an SRE could not predict costs from what is cited. Community comments about bills being easy to rack up or prices being fair do not document a transparent per-signal pricing scheme.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales
